name: popcorn-xp
description: Popcorn XP supports **extreme programming-style pair work** in multi-agent coding. The canonical source tree is `shared/`, `platforms/claude/` (**`popcorn-xp`**, **`popcorn-xp-team`**, **`shared/`** hook scripts + agents), and `platforms/codex/subagent/`; generated bundles such as `.claude-plugin/` and `.codex/` are outputs, not source.
